test_llvm_service_crash_recovery: test that the LLVM environment recovers gracefully when the service process is killed mid-episode
create_llvm_env_with_service_connection: create an LlvmEnv using a CompilerGymServiceConnection URL for unmanaged service connections
run_llvm_env_step_after_service_kill: run a step on the LLVM environment after the service dies and verify default values are returned
reset_llvm_env_with_benchmark: reset the LLVM environment with a specific benchmark like cbench-v1/crc32 and verify in_episode is true
configure_llvm_observation_and_reward_sp: configure the LLVM environment observation space to Autophase and reward space to IrInstructionCount
